# Sequence 9: SUPERMAN, THOR, AND WONDER WOMAN VS. THANOS

**Duration:** 01:05:00 (1560 frames, 25 shots) · **REC:** 01:09:06:12 - 01:10:11:12 · **Music:** 9M1 'Three Against the Titan' (percussion-led combat, each hero's motif on contact, Thanos motif gaining; strings hold under 'buying time')

**Purpose.** A spatially locked three-on-one: Thanos always on screen left driving right toward the platform; the heroes always between him and it. Every exchange shows anticipation, contact, follow-through, recovery and reaction. He wins the fight; they win the time.

**Staging rule.** Screen direction locked for the whole sequence: Thanos LEFT, heroes CENTRE, control platform and Heart RIGHT (background). Any shot that crosses the line is a deliberate reverse marked in its transition field.
